d: The TVK led administration in Tamil Nadu has escalated corruption probes against senior opposition leaders. Former School Education Minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi was remanded to judicial custody until November 6 following his arrest by the Central Crime Branch over an alleged ₹100-crore private school recognition scam. Concurrently, former Municipal Administration Minister K.N. Nehru faces DVAC action regarding alleged cash-for-jobs irregularities involving 2,538 engineering recruitments, with the Supreme Court declining to stall the probe. DMK President M.K.
